manaNeeded: {2}{U} plus enough mana to cast the copy spell {7}{U}{U}
notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
description:
Activate Thunderclap Drake by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing it.
Cast Rite of Replication by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Thunderclap Drake triggers, copying Rite of Replication at least twice, with all copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Rite of Replication spells, creating at least three copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers, causing you to win the game.
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating five token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game
